# Felipe Benguria

<div class="intro">
I am Associate Professor and Gatton Endowed Professor of Economics at the Department of Economics, Gatton College of Business, University of Kentucky. My research has been published in journals including The Review of Economic Studies, American Economic Review: Insights, American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics, Journal of Financial Economics, and Journal of International Economics. I have been a visitor, speaker or consultant at institutions including the IMF, the World Bank, the Inter-American Development Bank, and various central banks around the world. My research has been featured in The Economist, The Wall Street Journal, The Financial Times, and other media outlets. 
</div>
